title: Russian air defenses intercept 936 Ukrainian UAVs, seven smart bombs over past day
summary: Overall, the Russian Armed Forces have destroyed 674 Ukrainian combat aircraft, 284 helicopters, 240,045 unmanned aerial vehicles, 672 surface-to-air missile systems, 30,957 tanks and other armored combat vehicles

title: Kiev loses over 1,340 troops along engagement line in past day — Russia’s top brass
summary: The latest figures show that the Ukrainian army lost up to 245 troops in the responsibility area of Russia’s Battlegroup North, more than 210 troops in the responsibility area of the Battlegroup West and some 145 troops in the responsibility area of the Battlegroup South
